create_AsynchronousAgent: create an AsynchronousAgent wrapping a salina Agent to execute it in a separate process
run_AsynchronousAgent_call: run the AsynchronousAgent in non-blocking mode by calling it with keyword arguments
check_AsynchronousAgent_is_running: check if the AsynchronousAgent subprocess is still running and retrieve results when done
get_AsynchronousAgent_workspace: get the Workspace produced by the AsynchronousAgent after it finishes execution
close_AsynchronousAgent: close the AsynchronousAgent and terminate its subprocess cleanly
